documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Petro Carbon and Chemicals Limited reported its financial and operational performance for FY25, highlighting stable production and sales volumes despite margin compression from elevated raw material prices. Management discussed strategic initiatives including the commissioning of a 10 MW WHRB power plant, environmental clearance for capacity expansion, and the incorporation of new subsidiaries for backward integration and diversification. The company maintained a strong B2B customer base and noted ongoing industry headwinds such as import dependency and raw material price volatility. Petro Carbon and Chemicals Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, driven by higher sales, higher realisations, higher production, higher selling prices of CPC, and consequently higher gross profit margins. Turnover grew significantly to Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the fortune of the CPC industry is closely linked with the fortune of the aluminium industry.
demand_outlook.quote: Fortune of CPC industry is closely linked with the fortune of aluminium industry

demand_outlook.claim: The CPC industry is constrained by its reliance on imported green petroleum coke, which impacts supply stability and costs.
demand_outlook.quote: The CPC industry is constrained by its reliance on imported green petroleum coke, impacting supply stability and costs.

demand_outlook.claim: There are no commercially viable substitutes for CPC in aluminum smelting.
demand_outlook.quote: There are no commercially viable substitutes for CPC in aluminum smelting.

capex_expansion.claim: During FY 2024-25, a 10 Mega Watt Power Plant was commissioned at the Haldia Factory of the Company on 6th March, 2025 with an incurred capital expenditure of Rs. 7,111.77 lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: During the FY 2024-25, 10 Mega Watt Power Plant was commissioned at the Haldia Factory of the Company on 6th March, 2025 and the Company has incurred Capital Expenditure of Rs.7,111.77 lakhs for the same.

capex_expansion.claim: The company received approval from the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change for a proposed expansion project to install a 72,000 TPA Electrically Calcined Anthracite Plant, a 60,000 TPA Coal Tar Distillation Plant, and a 48,000 TPA revamping of the Old Carbon Paste Plant.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has got approval of Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India, vide their letter dated 23rd April, 2025, for proposed expansion project of the existing plant located in Haldia, West Bengal by installation of 72,000 TPA Electrically Calcined Anthracite Plant, 60,000 TPA Coal Tar Distillation Plant and 48,000 TPA by revamping of Old Carbon Paste Plant.

margins_costs.claim: Elevated raw material prices in FY25 could not be fully passed on to customers, resulting in margin compression.
margins_costs.quote: The CPC industry faced headwinds in FY 2025, primarily due to elevated raw material prices. These increases could not be fully passed on to customers, resulting in margin compression and a weakened bottom line across the sector.

orders_capacity.claim: The company currently operates one manufacturing plant located at Haldia with a capacity of approximately 93,744 tons per annum of CPC.
orders_capacity.quote: The Plant has a capacity of approximately 93,744 tons per annum of CPC and the plant comprises an area of around 30 acres with good infrastructure facilities like own railway sliding inside the plant premises itself facilitating unloading / loading of wagons, along with yard / shed to store both Raw Petroleum Coke (RPC) / Calcined Petroleum Coke (CPC).

orders_capacity.claim: Production of CPC for fiscal year 2024-25 was 84,305.500 MT against 91,541.200 MT in financial year 2023-24.
orders_capacity.quote: Production of CPC for fiscal year 2024-25 was 84,305.500 MT against 91,541.200 MT in financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: The Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year under review to conserve resources for future expansion and working capital requirements.
capital_allocation.quote: In order to conserve resources for future expansion and working capital requirements, your Directors have decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year under review.

risks_headwinds.claim: The CPC industry faced headwinds in FY 2025 primarily due to volatility and increases in raw material prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: The CPC industry faced headwinds in FY 2025, primarily due to elevated raw material prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heavy reliance on imports of low-sulphur RPC affects cost and availability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Heavy reliance on imports (esp. low-sulphur RPC from the U.S. and Other Europe and Asian countries) affects cost and availability.

risks_headwinds.claim: The energy-intensive calcination process raises operational costs during power and fuel inflation.
risks_headwinds.quote: Energy-intensive calcination process raises operational costs, especially during power/fuel inflation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Trade restrictions and anti-dumping duties in key markets impact pricing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Anti-dumping duties or export/import restrictions in key markets (e.g., China, USA and West Asia Market) impact pricing.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces foreign exchange risk because it imports more than 90% of its raw materials from foreign suppliers.
risks_headwinds.quote: The company imports more than 90% of its raw materials from foreign suppliers as a result of which the company faces foreign exchange risk.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fluctuations in crude oil prices affect both GPC and CPC prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Fluctuations in crude oil prices affect both GPC and CPC prices.

management_commitments.claim: The company adopted a forex policy in June 2023 which ensured 100% hedging, where the initial 50% of exposure is hedged immediately upon LC opening and the remaining 50% upon obtaining the SBLC due date.
management_commitments.quote: In order to minimize this risk, the company adopted a forex policy in June, 2023 which ensured 100% hedging. As per hedging policy, initial 50% of the exposure is hedged immediately on LC opening & remaining 50% hedging is done on obtaining SBLC due date.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
